# GeoCities 98

GeoCities 98 recreates a late-1990s web look with tiled starfields, Comic Sans headings, neon cyan and magenta links, gold first-level headings and animated GIF dividers. The recorded description also lists a spinning globe in the file list, a hit counter and flame in the status bar, Win98 bevel buttons, garish tag pills and sparkle bullets. Both modes exist, confetti in light and starfield in dark, and every GIF is stated to be embedded so the theme works offline.

![GeoCities 98 screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/b1rdmania/obsidian-geocities-98/HEAD/screenshot.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "GeoCities 98"
    author: "b1rdmania"
    repo:   "b1rdmania/obsidian-geocities-98"
    slug:   "geocities-98"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/geocities-98"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/b1rdmania/obsidian-geocities-98"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/b1rdmania/obsidian-geocities-98/HEAD/screenshot.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Relive the late‑90s web with a GeoCities‑era Obsidian skin: tiled starfields, Comic Sans headings, neon cyan and magenta links, gold H1s, and animated GIF dividers. Display a spinning globe in the file list, a hit counter and flame in the status bar, Win98 bevel buttons, garish tag pills and sparkle bullets, with both light (confetti) and dark (starfield) modes and all GIFs embedded for offline use."
}
```
